screens.name: Mobile Field Login & Session Authentication
screens.description: Secure, sunlight-readable authentication screen with role-aware profile detection, offline token caching indicators, and server connectivity validation.

states.loading: Disables input, renders high-contrast progress ring and 'Verifying Credentials...' label
states.error: Displays inline alert banner with specific failure reasons (Invalid credentials, Account suspended, IP restricted)
states.offline: Shows gold banner: 'Working in Offline Mode. Authenticating against local credential cache.'

screens.stitch_prompt: Create a high-density, professional mobile login screen (390x844) for an industrial heavy-equipment operations app named 'Alibaton Core 2'. The canvas is cool slate (#F8FAFC) with a crisp white card (#FFFFFF) having a 1px border (#E2E8F0) and 12px corner radius. At the top, show a bold industrial logo with a gold icon (#FFBF00) and title 'ALIBATON OPERATIONS' in Instrument Sans 600 graphite (#1E293B). Subtitle: 'Field Mobile Service & Heavy Crane Dispatch'. Form inputs have clear graphite labels, 48px height, subtle gray borders, and an eye toggle on the password field. The primary action button is a full-width 52px gold button (#FFBF00) with bold dark text 'Sign In to Operations'. Include an offline resilience pill at the bottom ('SQLite Sync Engine Ready • v2.0.0'). Clean, calm, zero decorative gradients.

screens.name: Today's Work & Shift Operations Dashboard
screens.description: Primary landing dashboard for field workers showing active shift timer, background GPS telemetry status, local outbox sync pill, and the prioritized list of assigned operational jobs.
screens.stitch_prompt: Create a high-density, touch-first mobile dashboard screen (390x844) for an industrial field crane operator named 'Marcus Tan'. Background is light cool slate (#F8FAFC). Top header bar contains operator avatar, name, green status dot ('Active Shift 04:18:22'), and a synchronization chip ('Online • Synced' in emerald green #16A34A). Main hero card: Crisp white card with 1px border displaying the Active Job 'DSP-2026-0894' for 'Jurong Island Berth 4' with a vibrant gold badge 'EN ROUTE' and a large 48px Cobalt Blue button (#2563EB) 'Open Active Journey HUD'. Below, render a clean segmented list of 'Today's Assigned Operations' with job cards showing site location, asset name (Liebherr 120T Crane), schedule time window, and color-coded status chips with text + icon. Bottom navigation bar with 4 tabs: 'Today's Work' (active gold), 'Inspections', 'Fuel', 'Profile'. High contrast, 48px minimum touch targets, zero clutter.

screens.name: Assignment Offer Review & Structured Response Modal
screens.description: Modal bottom-sheet presented to the field worker when a new dispatch or equipment assignment is dispatched by the Operations Manager, requiring explicit one-tap acceptance or structured rejection with mandatory reason code.

assignment_summary.client_contact: Jurong Town Corp / Site PIC: Dave Koh (+65 9123 4567)
assignment_summary.site_hazards: Overhead high-voltage 22kV powerlines within 20m; soft ground near canal bank

mandatory_rejection_reasons: Mandatory Rest Hours / Fatigue Limit Exceeded
rejection_flow.remarks_field: Additional operational notes for Operations Manager

screens.stitch_prompt: Create a high-urgency mobile bottom-sheet modal screen (390x844) for an incoming Crane Assignment Offer. The background is partially dimmed slate. The active white modal card (#FFFFFF) has rounded top corners (16px) with a prominent top grab handle. Header features a gold priority badge 'URGENT DISPATCH OFFER' and a timer countdown '14:22 remaining'. The body shows an assignment summary table: Job ID 'DSP-2026-0902', Location 'Pioneer Sector 3, Tuas Mega Yard', Scheduled Time 'Today @ 16:30', Machine '25T City Crane Kato CR-250Rv'. A high-contrast warning callout box with semantic orange/amber border (#EA580C) and AlertTriangle icon highlights: 'Hazard Alert: 22kV Overhead Powerlines near setup point'. Bottom action stack: Large full-width 52px Cobalt Blue button (#2563EB) 'Accept Assignment & Mobilize', and a secondary red-bordered button (#DC2626) 'Decline with Reason...'. Clear, decisive, high-contrast industrial styling.

screens.name: Heavy-Vehicle / Crane Route Navigation (Drive Mode HUD)
screens.description: Glanceable, voice/haptic-friendly driving HUD designed for heavy mobile cranes and transport prime movers. Displays bridge clearance corridor warnings, site entrance/gate instructions, route freshness, and zero-distraction arrival controls.

hud_header.destination_name: Jurong Port Gate 4 Heavy Staging Bay
hud_header.heavy_vehicle_clearance_status: Approved Heavy Corridor (Max Height 4.5m, Axle Limit 30T)

navigation_display.next_maneuver: In 400m, Turn Left onto Jurong Port Road Gate 4

ui_contract.safety_constraints: Map interaction is locked while vehicle velocity > 5 km/h. No multi-touch typing required.

screens.stitch_prompt: Create a high-contrast, glanceable mobile navigation HUD screen (390x844) for a driver maneuvering a 120-ton heavy crane. The top section is a dark graphite banner (#1E293B) with huge white typography: 'In 400m, Turn Left at Jurong Port Gate 4' accompanied by a bold white arrow icon. Next line shows ETA '14:15 (18 min remaining)'. In the center, show a stylized MapLibre navigation corridor map with a bright blue path line, highlighted site entrance gate marker, and a gold safety callout banner: 'Heavy Vehicle Corridor: Bridge Clearance 5.2m (Mast: 3.9m - PASS)'. The bottom action area features an extra-large 56px gold button (#FFBF00) with bold dark text 'Confirm Arrival at Site Gate' and a secondary button 'Report Traffic Delay'. Designed for instant glanceability under bright sunlight with maximum legibility.

screens.name: Parked-and-Secured Site Arrival Safety Checklist
screens.description: Mandatory safety gate immediately upon arrival. Requires physical confirmation of parking brake, wheel chocks, amber strobes, and ground stability before unlocking crane setup controls.

checklist_items.label: Air Parking Brake Engaged & Transmission in Neutral
Heavy-Duty Wheel Chocks Positioned (Front & Rear Axles)
checklist_items.description: Both drive axles secured against rollback

checklist_items.label: 360° Amber Warning Strobes & Hazard Beacons Activated
Initial Ground Bearing Inspection (Firm Concrete/Asphalt, No Subsidence)
checklist_items.description: Verified free of underground drains or sinkholes

actions.label: Confirm Vehicle Secured & Unlock Crane Setup

screens.stitch_prompt: Create an industrial mobile safety verification screen (390x844) titled 'Site Arrival & Vehicle Securing'. Canvas is cool slate (#F8FAFC). At the top, a prominent safety notice card with a semantic orange/amber warning border (#EA580C) reads: 'MANDATORY SAFETY GATE: Crane setup locked until vehicle is immobilized and secured.' Below, display 4 large interactive safety toggle cards with generous 48px touch targets: 1) 'Air Parking Brake Engaged', 2) 'Heavy-Duty Wheel Chocks Positioned', 3) '360° Amber Warning Strobes Active', 4) 'Ground Bearing Surface Checked'. Each toggle features an unmistakable checkbox/switch and descriptive helper text. Bottom button is a full-width 52px gold button (#FFBF00) 'Confirm Vehicle Secured & Unlock Crane Setup' (enabled state with green check icon). Clean, strict, and compliant with industrial safety standards.

screens.name: Crane Setup & 15m Exclusion Zone Verification
screens.description: Interactive crane setup workspace verifying 4-point hydraulic outrigger pad positioning, live anemometer wind speed telemetry, powerline clearance, and the 15-meter safety exclusion zone.

setup_components.title: 15m Swing Radius Exclusion Zone
items: 15m barricade tape and safety cones deployed around counterweight swing radius
Overhead 22kV electrical clearance > 6.0m verified by Site Rigger
Rigger & Signalman certified communications check (Radio Channel 4)

actions.label: Authorize Crane Setup & Begin Lift Operations

screens.stitch_prompt: Create an interactive crane setup safety screen (390x844) for a mobile crane operator. Clean slate canvas (#F8FAFC). At the top, show a live Anemometer Wind Speed card with an emerald green progress bar (#16A34A) reading '14 km/h (Safe Limit: 38 km/h)'. In the center, display a 2x2 grid representing the crane chassis and 4 hydraulic outrigger pads: 'Front Left', 'Front Right', 'Rear Left', 'Rear Right', each with a bright green verified checkmark and '100% Extended • Steel Mats In Place'. Below, show a high-contrast card for '15m Exclusion Zone Barricades' with checked toggles for swing radius clearance and radio communication check. Action button: Large 52px Cobalt Blue button (#2563EB) 'Authorize Crane Setup & Begin Lift Operations'. Ultra-clean, authoritative engineering feel.

screens.name: Construction On-Site Operations & Time Allocation Hub
screens.description: Active construction on-site execution screen for real-time tracking of operational hours, recording billable client standby demurrage delays, monitoring environmental safety limits, and requesting field support.

demurrage_time_allocation.client_standby_hours: 01h 27m (Waiting on Riggers/Client • Billed at contract rate)

screens.stitch_prompt: Create a streamlined industrial mobile site operations screen (390x844) titled 'Construction On-Site Operations'. Background is cool slate (#F8FAFC). Header features Job ID 'DSP-2026-0894 - MRT Extension', active green pill 'WORKING ON SITE', and monospace timer pill '05:42:18'. Hero section is an Operational Time Allocation card with a '05h 42m Total On-Site' header and a segmented progress bar breaking down Productive Operation (04h 15m in green), Client Standby / Demurrage (01h 27m in gold), and Weather Hold (00h 00m). Features a gold outline button '+ Log Standby / Client Delay'. Card 2 is Site Environmental & Machine Telemetry with 3-column grid (Wind 16 km/h, Hydraulic Temp 68°C, Fuel 72%). Card 3 has a 48px Slate outline button 'Request On-Site Fuel Bowser'. Bottom action: Full-width 52px Dark Graphite button (#1E293B) 'Complete Shift & Open Sign-off Report'. High daylight contrast, glove-friendly touch targets, no lift counters.

screens.name: Job Completion Report & Supervisor Sign-off
screens.description: Final operational completion report capturing lift summary, total machine hours, site photo attachments with SHA-256 cryptographic hashes, and digital supervisor sign-off.

photo_attachments.label: Site Completion & Rigging Demobilization Photos (Max 10 files)

signature_block.signature_pad: Digital Canvas with Clear and Save

screens.stitch_prompt: Create an industrial mobile completion report and digital sign-off screen (390x844). Slate background (#F8FAFC). Top summary card shows: Total Lifts (10/10), Total Operating Hours (6.5 hrs), Demurrage Standby (1.5 hrs), and Closing Hour Meter (1,426.8 hrs). Middle section displays a Photo Attachment Card showing 2 uploaded site photos with green verified badges and a '+ Add Photo' slot. Bottom section contains a Client Sign-off Box with name input 'Dave Koh (JTC)', a clean digital signature box showing a signed stroke, and an audit timestamp. Bottom action: 52px full-width gold button (#FFBF00) 'Submit Signed Report & Release Dispatch'. High-trust, professional, audit-ready layout.

screens.name: 5-Tab Equipment Inspection Suite & Safety Lockout
screens.description: Comprehensive 5-tab mobile inspection tool (Hydraulics, Structural, Engine & Fluids, Controls, Safety Devices) with 3-state cycling toggles (Pass / Attention / Critical Defect) and instant safety lockout upon critical failure.

checklist_items.name: Main Boom Telescoping Cylinders & Hoses
checklist_items.description: Check for oil seepage, bulging, or crimp wear

checklist_items.name: Outrigger Jack Cylinders & Check Valves
checklist_items.description: Zero drift under pressure holding test

checklist_items.name: Hydraulic Pump Noise & Pressure Relief
checklist_items.description: Pressure steady at 320 bar with no cavitation
checklist_items.notes: Minor pressure pulsation observed at idle

ui_contract.lockout_behavior: Marking any item as Critical Defect instantly triggers a red lockout banner and routes asset to 'Maintenance Required' state.

screens.stitch_prompt: Create an industrial 5-tab mobile inspection checklist screen (390x844) for a heavy equipment technician. Header displays asset 'Liebherr 120T Crane (CR-120-04)' and an overall inspection status badge. Top horizontal scrollable tab bar features 5 tabs: 'Hydraulics' (active gold underline), 'Structural', 'Engine', 'Controls', 'Safety'. The body features inspection checklist cards. Each item contains an item title, description, and 3 high-contrast pill toggles: [Pass (Green)], [Attention (Gold)], [Critical Defect (Red)]. Item 3 shows 'Attention' selected with a gold notes chip and '1 photo attached'. Bottom footer has a 48px Cobalt Blue button (#2563EB) 'Save & Next Tab: Structural'. Crisp white cards with 1px gray borders on cool slate canvas (#F8FAFC).

screens.name: Maintenance Defect Order & Safe-Release Certification
screens.description: Work order screen for logging defects, replacement parts, repair notes, and executing the mandatory post-repair Safe-Release Return-to-Service digital certification.

defect_details.reported_issue: Hydraulic main hoist relief valve seal blown during morning inspection
defect_details.remedial_action_taken: Replaced high-pressure seal kit (Part #KV-902-SEAL) and flushed circuit

safe_release_gate.title: Post-Repair Return-to-Service Certification
criteria: Post-repair pressure test completed at 280 bar (Passed)
3-cycle full boom extension without hydraulic drop (Passed)

actions.label: Certify Safe-Release & Return Asset to Fleet

screens.stitch_prompt: Create an industrial maintenance repair and safe-release certification screen (390x844). Background is cool slate (#F8FAFC). Header features Work Order 'WO-2026-0419' for 'Kato 25T Crane' with a high-contrast red badge 'DISPATCH BLOCKING DEFECT'. Body contains 3 sections: 1) Defect & Action Summary card with clear monospace part numbers; 2) Parts Consumed list with quantity counters; 3) Safe-Release Return-to-Service Card highlighted with an emerald green border (#16A34A) and 3 passing checkmark items. Bottom contains the technician signature box and a full-width 52px Emerald Green button (#16A34A) 'Certify Safe-Release & Return Asset to Fleet'. Clean, accountable, compliance-ready.

The body features a comparison card with 3 rows comparing 'Checkout Baseline' vs 'Return Actual': 1) Hours: '1,420.5 hrs' ➔ '1,498.2 hrs' (+77.7 hrs, neutral slate); 2) Fuel: '100%' ➔ '65%' (Gold badge: 'Refueling Charge Due'); 3) Body: 'Clean' ➔ 'Dent on right panel' (Red badge: 'Damage Flagged' with 2 photo thumbnails). screens.stitch_prompt: Create an authoritative legal handover and fleet decommissioning screen (390x844). Background is cool slate (#F8FAFC). Top section contains a Gold/Charcoal legal advisory card: 'TERMINAL TRANSACTION: Transferring title permanently transfers ownership and decommissions asset from Alibaton operational fleet.' Body features Buyer Signatory Details (Engr. Jonathan Lim - Director of Plant) and a clean, high-contrast digital signature pad with a bold signature stroke. At the bottom, a metadata chip displays GPS coordinates and timestamp. Action button is a massive 56px Dark Charcoal button (#1E293B) with white text 'Confirm Handover & Decommission from Fleet'. Authoritative, clean, and legally conclusive.
